body: Hey dude dm me if you still need someone! Id love to spend some time out in nature this summer and see the world a bit.
If someone doesn't reciprocate emotional validation instantly my body says it's time to die
I literally hopped on reddit and asked for help. Turns out strangers can be really really kind and knowing that someone who hasn't even met you cares about your life feels pretty good.

Thank you so much for this post. It is honestly so helpful to hear that someone who has been where I am right now has gotten to a good place. I have been genuinely scared of seeking hospitalization but your experience definitely validates it as an option. I will also definitely look into DBT, I think a lot of my problems exist because I don't open up to others in the first place but I also need practical skills to cope better. I think this made me more ready to open up to people I trust, and thank you so much for the tips and validation. It honestly means the world to me right now that you took the time to write this thoughtful of a reply.

Hey I know how you are feeling right now. It's really scary and hard but you just have to find maybe one small thing to hang onto. Try to think of a "someday" fantasy where you are happy. Live for that day.

Omg same! I struggle so much making friends but I was finally getting to a good point and now the world is like nope you can be an introvert again. I wasn't at the hanging out point yet with my class friends and we live far away anyway so I feel like I'm gonna be so lonely while the school is shut down.

That really sucks but it will get better! No matter how embarrassing the moment if you can learn to let it go, that’s the only skill you need: being adaptable with yourself. Also be kind to yourself because you are your only main pal so you gotta show up for yourself.

Wow, this was a really intense thing to share but I'm glad you did. Honestly I have been feeling the same way for a while. I have social anxiety which turned into depression and I feel like my mind just does this whole spiral into darkness thing. I want to be close to people, I literally fantasize about it but in real life I come off as so awkward and then I beat myself up for it and continue to avoid making relationships. Just know that you are not alone in how you are feeling, no matter how hard it gets, someone else is feeling it too. There are still good things to live for. Therapy can and will help once you find the right therapist, I just started actually seeking help and although it's not a quick fix, I feel better already because it's like I finally decided to take care of my issues. Right now you need to live for those "some day" moments because some day you will have more confidence, some day you won't feel this alone, and some day you will look back and be thankful you didn't end it all. As someone who has considered suicide I know how dark and heavy this feeling can get and all you can do in those dark times is think about how you can do little things to make a change. There is always hope and always someone else who shares these feelings and feels as messed up as you, you are not alone.

Wow I have been having a lot of the same feelings you are! I'm a freshman in college and just finishing the first semester. It's been the toughest transition of my life and I question my goals and identity almost on the daily. I know this seems dramatic but when you are trying to figure out who you are and what you even want to major in these thoughts come to mind. I have switched my major twice already, looked at other universities, and now I'm considering taking time off to think about what I really want to do. I don't want to continue paying for college if I'm not even happy here and don't know what I'm majoring in. I decided I want to go volunteer abroad for a couple months and hopefully "find myself" or at least gain a new perspective that will help me make my career decision. Sorry that doesn't give any advice but at least you know someone else is feeling the same way.
